viewing, comparison, and organization.</td><td>Lacks a unified space for organizing multimedia; side-by-side comparison typically requires switching windows or using other tools.</td></tr><tr><th scope="row">Multimedia generation</th><td>Native image, video, speech, and music generation, with outputs ready for websites, apps, presentations, and content tasks.</td><td>Multimedia generation capabilities are fragmented; products without full image, video, speech, and music coverage need external services to complete creative work.</td></tr><tr><th scope="row">Finance and enterprise data</th><td>Connects to local Chinese data services such as the Hundsun financial database and Qichacha for financial research and company information queries.</td><td>General-purpose or global data connections are more common; specialized Chinese sources such as Hundsun and Qichacha typically require additional integration.</td></tr><tr><th scope="row">Free use</th><td>Log in daily to claim free credits and try programming, office work, content creation, and other tasks.</td><td>No mechanism for earning free credits through daily login.</td></tr></tbody></table></div></section><section data-testid="download-faq-module"><div class="download-faq-module__heading-group"><h2 id="download-faq-module-title" class="download-faq-module__heading">Frequently asked questions</h2></div><div class="download-faq-module__items"><article class="download-faq-module__item"><h3 class="download-faq-module__question-heading"><button aria-controls="download-faq-getting_started" aria-expanded="false" class="download-faq-module__question" type="button"><span>How do I get started with MiniMax Code?</span><span aria-hidden="true" class="download-faq-module__icon"></span></button></h3><div aria-hidden="true" class="grid grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)] transition-[grid-template-rows,opacity] duration-200 ease-out motion-reduce:transition-none opacity-0 download-faq-module__answer-reveal" style="grid-template-rows:minmax(0, 0fr)"><div aria-hidden="true" class="min-w-0 overflow-hidden "><div id="download-faq-getting_started" class="download-faq-module__answer" role="region" aria-label="How do I get started with MiniMax Code?"><p>After installing and signing in, describe the task you want to complete on the home page, such as organizing a report, analyzing files, or creating a website. You can drag in reference files or select a local project folder and explain the result you want. Once you send your request, MiniMax Code will start working, and you can add requirements or adjust direction at any time.</p></div></div></div></article><article class="download-faq-module__item"><h3 class="download-faq-module__question-heading"><button aria-controls="download-faq-desktop_web" aria-expanded="false" class="download-faq-module__question" type="button"><span>What is the difference between MiniMax Code for desktop and MiniMax Agent on the web?</span><span aria-hidden="true" class="download-faq-module__icon"></span></button></h3><div aria-hidden="true" class="grid grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)] transition-[grid-template-rows,opacity] duration-200 ease-out motion-reduce:transition-none opacity-0 download-faq-module__answer-reveal" style="grid-template-rows:minmax(0, 0fr)"><div aria-hidden="true" class="min-w-0 overflow-hidden "><div id="download-faq-desktop_web" class="download-faq-module__answer" role="region" aria-label="What is the difference between MiniMax Code for desktop and MiniMax Agent on the web?"><p>MiniMax Code is better suited to tasks that need local files, code projects, and tools on your computer. You can connect a project folder and, with your permission, read and modify files, run commands, and work with the terminal, built-in browser, and plugins. MiniMax Agent on the web requires no installation: open your browser to start cloud tasks such as online research, content generation, and information organization.</p><p>With local-cloud collaboration, you can also hand off a desktop task to the cloud along with its context and required files, then follow up on the web without describing your requirements again. Once the task is complete, you can download the results. For tasks linked to a local directory, you can also review file differences and sync them back locally after confirmation.</p></div></div></div></article><article class="download-faq-module__item"><h3 class="download-faq-module__question-heading"><button aria-controls="download-faq-coding_work" aria-expanded="false" class="download-faq-module__question" type="button"><span>Is MiniMax Code only for writing code?</span><span aria-hidden="true" class="download-faq-module__icon"></span></button></h3><div aria-hidden="true" class="grid grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)] transition-[grid-template-rows,opacity] duration-200 ease-out motion-reduce:transition-none opacity-0 download-faq-module__answer-reveal" style="grid-template-rows:minmax(0, 0fr)"><div aria-hidden="true" class="min-w-0 overflow-hidden "><div id="download-faq-coding_work" class="download-faq-module__answer" role="region" aria-label="Is MiniMax Code only for writing code?"><p>No. MiniMax Code offers both Coding and Work modes.</p><p>Coding mode keeps development context such as projects, terminals, and code management. Work mode reduces technical details and is better suited for research, documents, presentations, data organization, websites, and other office tasks. The modes mainly differ in interface and default workflow—choose the one that best fits your task.</p></div></div></div></article><article class="download-faq-module__item"><h3 class="download-faq-module__question-heading"><button aria-controls="download-faq-skills_plugins" aria-expanded="false" class="download-faq-module__question" type="button"><span>What are skills and plugins for, and how do they differ?</span><span aria-hidden="true" class="download-faq-module__icon"></span></button></h3><div aria-hidden="true" class="grid grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)] transition-[grid-template-rows,opacity] duration-200 ease-out motion-reduce:transition-none opacity-0 download-faq-module__answer-reveal" style="grid-template-rows:minmax(0, 0fr)"><div aria-hidden="true" class="min-w-0 overflow-hidden "><div id="download-faq-skills_plugins" class="download-faq-module__answer" role="region" aria-label="What are skills and plugins for, and how do they differ?"><p>A skill is a documented professional workflow: it tells an Agent what to do first for a particular task, which tools to use, and how to check the result—for example when creating presentations, analyzing data, designing a website, or organizing documents.</p><p>Plugins add tools and external services that can actually be called, such as Feishu, browsers, databases, and other applications. Some plugins also include companion skills.</p></div></div></div></article><article class="download-faq-module__item"><h3 class="download-faq-module__question-heading"><button aria-controls="download-faq-scheduled_tasks" aria-expanded="false" class="download-faq-module__question" type="button"><span>Can MiniMax Code automatically complete tasks on a schedule?</span><span aria-hidden="true" class="download-faq-module__icon"></span></button></h3><div aria-hidden="true" class="grid grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)] transition-[grid-template-rows,opacity] duration-200 ease-out motion-reduce:transition-none opacity-0 download-faq-module__answer-reveal" style="grid-template-rows:minmax(0, 0fr)"><div aria-hidden="true" class="min-w-0 overflow-hidden "><div id="download-faq-scheduled_tasks" class="download-faq-module__answer" role="region" aria-label="Can MiniMax Code automatically complete tasks on a schedule?"><p>Yes. Scheduled tasks let you arrange recurring work such as daily or weekly reports, information organization, and periodic checks. After you set the task instructions and execution time, MiniMax Code will run it as scheduled and show the results in the corresponding conversation. Scheduled tasks depend on the desktop app running: your computer must stay awake and the app must remain running for tasks to execute on time.</p></div></div></div></article></div></section><section
